how: We read the website of every Austin wedding videographer listed on Lazo (85 listings, 73 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a live-streaming company, a photo booth maker, a Colorado videographer listed in Austin, a multi-state studio network, a booking marketplace and multi-service franchises. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is the ceremony audio recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera, and how do you handle wind on an outdoor Hill Country site?
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?
Is there an hourly cap, and what does it cost if the reception runs late?

picks.name: Moonlit Weddings
picks.blurb: Jake McDonald started Moonlit Weddings in 2014 with one camera and a borrowed tripod; twelve years later it is a small crew that films one wedding a day and stays out of the way. Every collection includes 4K, drone footage and licensed music, and the prices are on the page, from $3,800 at our read.

picks.name: Photohouse Films
picks.blurb: PhotoHouse Films makes wedding films and photography for modern couples who value story, presence and timeless craft. Founded by Will Herrington, the studio is based in Austin, travels worldwide, and describes its work as honest stories told with care and intention.

picks.name: Reid and Co. Films
picks.blurb: Reid and Co. Films crafts cinematic wedding films with a documentary-inspired storytelling style, for what it calls intentional couples. Based in Round Rock, the team covers Austin, Houston, Dallas and San Antonio and is available for destination weddings.

picks.name: Lona Weddings
picks.blurb: Lona Weddings adapts its editing style to each couple, with no templates, generic music or cookie-cutter moments. The Austin team offers three services in one commitment, videography, photography and content creation, and is available for travel.

picks.name: Thats Amore Films
picks.blurb: That's Amore Films is based in both Austin and Dallas and is known for non-traditional wedding films. Owner Anthony has produced wedding films for more than 11 years, the studio offers four main video packages, and it is available for destination weddings worldwide.

picks.name: Travel Weddings Photography & Videography
picks.blurb: Travel Weddings is founder Jasna Boudard, French and Bangladeshi by heritage, who has explored 35 countries and speaks English, French, Spanish, Bangla and some Japanese. The Austin studio does photography and videography for multicultural unions and couples who love to travel.

picks.name: Roman P. Photography
picks.blurb: Roman is a wedding photographer and filmmaker serving the greater Austin area from Round Rock, with his wife Mila, in a style he calls organic and journalistic. Packages include unlimited hours of coverage on the wedding day and full-resolution images with full rights.

picks.name: Cloud Craft Studios
picks.blurb: Dave and Sarah Kemper are the husband-and-wife duo behind Cloud Craft Studios in Austin, shooting both photo and video together. They blend real moments with a bit of direction so everything looks as good as it felt, thoughtfully planned but never forced.

picks.name: Blissful Films - Texas Wedding Videography
picks.blurb: Blissful Films is a boutique wedding videography and photography team that promises to curate, direct, film and edit the day so you can relive it. The site spells out the booking terms: an $800 non-refundable deposit and a signed contract hold your date, and Texas sales tax applies to every package.

picks.name: Thirdeyestudio
picks.blurb: Thirdeyestudio is a collective of photographers and filmmakers founded by PV Subramanian in 2009, documenting Indian, Pakistani and fusion weddings from Austin. Offerings are customizable by hours, price point and outputs, so film and photo can be quoted together.

picks.name: Chhaya Photography
picks.blurb: Chhaya Photography specializes in Nepali wedding photography, covering haldi and mehendi ceremonies through the traditional ceremony, and offers helicopter aerial photography. A complete wedding package pairs photography with video, out of Georgetown.
